item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera keeps a potted tulsi plant on her balcony. During the day the plant both photosynthesises and respires. Which statement correctly compares the two processes?

options.A: Photosynthesis releases energy from glucose, while respiration makes glucose using sunlight.
options.B: Photosynthesis makes glucose and oxygen using sunlight, while respiration breaks glucose with oxygen to release energy.
options.C: Photosynthesis and respiration are the same process of gas exchange happening in the leaves.
options.D: Photosynthesis uses oxygen and releases carbon dioxide, while respiration uses carbon dioxide and releases oxygen.
